Q: Node-Postgres Error: timeout exceeded when trying to connect A:

This happens when queries exceed the timeout waiting for a connection from the Postgres connection pool. The cause is a combination of slow queries and too much parallelism (i.e. if the Postgres pool accepts 10 connections at once per process, and if queries have to wait in the queue longer than the allowed timeout, this error occurs).

Reducing parallelism on intense batch queries has mitigated this error in cases I've seen.

Example stack trace:

Error: timeout exceeded when trying to connect
  File "/usr/src/app/backend/node_modules/pg-pool/index.js", line 200, in Timeout._onTimeout
    response.callback(new Error('timeout exceeded when trying to connect'))
  File "node:internal/timers", line 559, in listOnTimeout
  File "node:internal/timers", line 502, in processTimers

Q: karate: Picking up feature files from absolute class path A:

First - no one has ever reported this problem and teams normally don't need to bundle tests into a JAR.

Second - if you use the classpath: prefix, you should be able to load feature files from within even JAR files. So please use it and it is documented here: https://github.com/intuit/karate#reading-files

* def result = call read('classpath:some-reusable-steps.feature')

If this does not solve the problem, please follow the instructions here and submit an issue: https://github.com/intuit/karate/wiki/How-to-Submit-an-Issue - please explain what you are trying to do differently also.

Q: How can I make the yellow color in the “No” cells disappear whenever I add a date next to that cell? A:

try:

=(C2="No")*ISBLANK(D2)

apply to C2:C

also keep in mind that conditional formating rules abide hierarchy top to bottom so applied is only the first rule that satisfies conditions.
